ru.command: {KeyBind:GrabOrGuard} Возможно использование из быстрого слота Используется с клинком

en.name: Flash Bondage
en.description: Throw your sura katanas forward, binding the enemy to the ground, then quickly slashing them upon its return.
en.command: {KeyBind:GrabOrGuard} Can be added to a Quick Slot Can be used with your shortsword
tooltip: Not affected by effects which increase/decrease Attack and/or Casting Speeds.
